encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

cRefPattern.p: This pointer pattern extracts lines within fragments.

revisionDesc.change: Split the volume-level OCR draft into canonical TLG author and work files. Running-head continuations were folded into their works; wording was not corrected. The page image remains authoritative and the transcription requires human review.

lg.l: ὄνος μὲν ὀγκᾶθ’ ὁ Μελιτεὺς Φιλωνίδης.

div.note: Schol. Aristoph. Plut. 179 κωμῳδεῖται δὲ (Φιλωνίδης) ὡς εὔπορος (?) καὶ ὡς μέγας τῷ σώματι καὶ ἠλίθιος . . . Θεόπομπος Ἀφροδισίοις κτλ.

ὀγκᾶθ’] ὠγκᾶθ’ Bergk. R. c. Att. 400. Μελιτεύς Bentl.] μελίτου Ald. ἔβλαστεν πόλει Meinek.] ἔβλαστε τῇ πόλει. duo fragmenta esse statuit Meinekius, aut ὄνῳ δὲ aut ὃς ὄνῳ scribebat Bergkius. fortasse duo conloquuntur: tum scribendum ὄνῳ γε. de Philonide disputaverunt Hanovius Exercit. crit. 27. 34 et Bergkius R. c. Att. 400—405, asini nomen non tam ad magnitudinem quam ad oris corporisque turpitudinem referens. de syntaxi verborum ὄνος ὀγκᾶται cf. Cratin. 52.

lg.l: τὴν σηπίαν τηνδὶ λαβοῦσα καὶ τοδὶ
